Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Dink Winkerson here for Danville Today. Temperatures surge as we hit record-breaking levels of heat. I was going to suggest you wear sunscreen and stay hydrated, but that seems inadequate now.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Man, it's hot! It is so hot!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (shvitzing) He is redundant, but he is right. I do wish we could luge the heat.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (fanning herself) Wait, did you say "luge the heat"?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I mispronounced, okay? I am melting!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, maybe we could lose the heat by lugeing. You know, hurtling down a big sledding track in the snow.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sarcastically) Great, an activity that takes seventeen seconds, den I'm hot again!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Fair, but what if we made a luge track that never ended? Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Make the world's first endless luge track!

Name: The gang
Dialog: (cheers)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (monotone) I dunno, Stacy. With the A/C on the fritz, I don't have the energy to move. I don't even feel like busting my brothers.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: If it's this hot, your brothers could be taking it easy, too. (sighs) Perfect!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, maybe you're right. (She puts her phone away from her ear to reveal it is flaming.) Okay, gotta go. My phone's overheating.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, a cool breeze. Did someone fix the A/C?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You were right, Ferb. Most people would scoff at the idea of building a frozen luge track on the hottest day of summer. And yet, here we are.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb. Ironically, the coolness they created gave me the energy to bust them for the coolness they created! Hee hee hee! (backs away)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. Hope you're enjoying that fresh glass of lemonade.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters and shivers)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It took us all morning to hand-squeeze those lemons. And by "us", I mean Carl.

Name: Carl
Dialog: My hands are still pruney. (He shows his wrinkled hand.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyways, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted outside the Danville Water Park with a preposterous amount of Doonkelberry oil. Water and oil don't mix. He must be up to something nefarious.

Name: Major Mongram
Dialog: Go stop 'im, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Keep fanning, Carl! Lunch isn't for another forty-five minutes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Backyard! Boys! Invention!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Just a minute, honey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But the boys made a giant luge wheel and—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Is one more minute really gonna make that much of a difference?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine. Backyard. One minute.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no, no, nooo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: All done. Okay, what did you want to show me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, Mom. One minute really is going to make that much of a difference.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, I'm off to Charlene's to return her cake pan. You might want to stay inside. I'm worried the heat's making you see things.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is Mom right? Could this all be a temperature-induced hallucination?

Name: Talking Zebra
Dialog: Oh, I don't think so, Kevin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, you're right. Thanks, Talking Zebra!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The squeaky wheel may get the grease, but that frozen wheel is so getting busted!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah-ah-ah, Perry the Platypus. Park policy states that you can't enter without a wristband. Luckily, I always carry extra wrist-oriented ornamentation. Here, admission for one.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Into my trap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (laughs) Also, you owe me $40. (wheels into the park) Now, you may be confused about why I have an industrial-sized vat of Doonkelberry oil. Back in Drusselstein, we used Doonkelberry oil for everything: skin care, verb conjugation, making scented candles, but strangely not Doonkelberry-scented candles, vanilla mango for some reason. Anyway, so when I saw it on sale, I may have gone a little overboard.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But where to store it all? Obvious answer, the water park.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, no, stay with me. It makes sense. Back in Drusselstein, the kids would all go to the local oil park, like a water park, but slipperier.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) I never got to go in myself, but I remember looking through the fence when my brother, Roger had his birthday party there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But it looked like fun! So with this dry-inator, I'll zap away all the water, and then I can replace it with my Doonkelberry oil. Then I can finally have fun at the oil park, and Roger's not invited! (He dumps Perry into the recycling bin, but the oil drum accidentally steps on his foot.) Ow! Oh! I use that foot for walking!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Someone dare me to lick this thing!

Name: The gang
Dialog: Don't lick it, Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Fine. How does this work anyway?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, the slowly melting ice of the wheel creates a slick surface, eliminating friction. (Close-up on Baljeet.) Gravity converts into angular momentum, giving us perpetual mo—Hello?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: He licked it.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I licked it! (yelps)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (laughs) Such is the karmic cycle of angular momentum!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait, where'd he go?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I'm up on top! I do not know how I got here!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry! Ferb's got ya!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whoo! (grunts) Thank you!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: No problem.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not... getting... away... that... easily!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What the?

Name: Ice cream truck man
Dialog: The heat has gone and melted our comically oversized fudge pops. Probably shouldn't have put it on the roof. Or made it out of fudge.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) Fine, I'll have to go on foot.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a sec. Hmmm, maybe.

Name: Salesman
Dialog: I'd usually charge you for that, but I see you're in a song sequence!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, hello, Vanessa. I'm so glad you called.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Have you seen my hair dryer?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh, well, I may have enlarged it a little to make it a dry-it-off-inator, but—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what did we agree after the vegan rodeo incident?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (begrudgingly) "We don't make inators out of Vanessa's things."

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) Whatever. (hangs up)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pretending Vanessa is still there) Oh, uh, yeah, thank you. I am the greatest dad ever. Thank you for noticing. ("hangs up") Okay, first things first. Use my dry-it-off-inator to remove all the water, so I can then replace it with my Doonkelberry oil.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, baby!

Name: Mother
Dialog: Oscar, please stop crying.

Name: Oscar
Dialog: I can't! (He gets zapped by the inator.) Oh, I guess I can.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woohoo! (dials phone) Mom, Mom, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time to explain! I need you to head down to 4th Street!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, well, I have to take 4th anyway.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, isn't that your sister?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: She appears to be skiing down the frozen wake left by the wheel.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace! If you want to grab a luge, we'll pick ya up on the way back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I do not want to grab a luge!

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: Dink Winkerson here. We've caught up to the mysterious summer skier. What's your secret to keeping cool?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I guess it's this giant wheel of ice. Wait, am I on TV?

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: You will be at 4:00, when we'll find out who is she, where did she come from, and what's up with her neck? Stay tuned!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Mom, look left! Now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, donuts! Want me to pick some up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! I mean, sure, chocolate glaze! Then get to the water park!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my goodness! Would you look at that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You actually see it? Phineas and Ferb made that!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, honey, even you can't think the boys made a tortoise.

Name: Linda
Dialog: The heat is getting to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaaaah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, come on in. The Doonkelberry oil's fine. (He drops some oil drums.) And slippery, baby!

Name: Kid
Dialog: I regret nothiiiiiiiiing!

Name: Kid
Dialog: I'm okay!

Name: Kid
Dialog: I'm less okay now.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, looks like oil and platypuses don't mix either! Ha ha! There's no way for you to get up here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What are you, part-salmon?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Something is interfering with the friction of the wheel! We are losing control!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Abandon wheel!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, honey, I'm here with your donuts.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on phone) What part of the park are you in?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Prepare to dry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: There! I'm right by the...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wuh? Whuh thu...?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, are you still there?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Stand still.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, the shark jumped us!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, where are you going?! Oh, crud.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: You're telling me we only got vinegar for this giant salad? What are we gonna tell all these hungry vegetarians?

Name: Nerd
Dialog: Uh, I aksed for mine on the side.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, there you are. So what exactly am I supposed to be seeing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The boys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, kids!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, why are you dressed like that? I told you, you're going to get a heatstroke!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wai-wa-wa-wait, what time is it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: It's 4:00, but why—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Turn on the news!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (yelps)

Name: Dink Winkerson
Dialog: (on TV) Dink Winkerson here. It's a hundred and four degrees, and one local resident wants to hit the slopes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but, but, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey! It's the tortoise I saw earlier. Isn't that the most outrageous thing you've ever seen?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dryly) Not even today.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Look like Perry's bringing his own version of cool.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)
